posts.name: Arcanist Lupus
posts.cooked:
Lordy.

AZ, Young Legacy, F6 Bunker, Eternal Haka, and Freedom Wraith dove underwater to deal with an Advanced Matriarch in the Ruins of Atlantis.

 

It started out pretty easy.  Legacy had Fortitude and Lead from the Front quickly, and spent a great deal of time tanking damage.  Huginn came out quickly, but Munnin did not, and she had opened with one of her Horrid Cacophonies before we'd played anything, so we got set up for beat downs without problem.  And then a Ground Pound - Internal Combustion boardwipe combo was interupted by a Leaking Room (Bunker was before Haka, you see), and things started going to hell.  The Leaking Room was followed by a Horrid Cacophony which wiped our defenses, and then a Phosphorescent Chamber on the next round, which dropped our health from the 20s to single digits across the board.  We almost won that round, but Haka of Battle isn't much use without a damaging power, which Eternal Haka lacked.  So I held on a Rampage and prayed Haka could survive until the next round.  And then the environment played Mystical Defenses.  Which wiped the birdies, and started dishing out damage to us.  And we didn't have Lead from the Front anymore to protect us.  Fortunately, we did have Smoke Bombs, and enough equipment hanging around to avoid the Matriarch's damage.  So everyone was brought down to 6 hp, where we stayed as everyone was simultaneously the lowest hp.  (Which, incidentally, takes a ridiculously long time to resolve.  For every bird destroyed, for each Carrion Field, I had to first pick the highest hp.  Then I had to "choose for me" the order the rest would be damaged.  Then I had to, for four heroes, agree that that hero was the lowest hp, and then pick the "highest hp" hero.  That's 10 choices per carrion field, or 20 choices per dying bird, or about 200 choices overall.)

Finally I survived the environment turn.  Matriarch's turn was mercifully boring, and I passed along to Haka, who rampaged over her face to victory.
